body: Retroactive filing: this work landed and was marked [x] in BACKLOG.md without an Apple, a real gap in the Emily Way's audit trail discipline caught during a full-process audit pass. gpt2-alpine-c/pkg/towerprint -- Go port of the founder's 2020 QUEENSALLYONLINEBOOKOFMAGIFICATIONANDUNICOR squish/tower/gematria pipeline (repo's first Go module, joined to root go.work). Archaeology verdict: the notebook-only trxtwr/magicVVVDecTower family is the evolved final version, core of the port (Tower/MagicTower); MTRXTWER/PRINTWR kept as MatrixTower/ClassicTower for compatibility. Codzeify uses math/big for Python-int parity; the hand-written magicVVVLookup table is now derived from the 3x8 VVV grid and test-verified against the original entry-for-entry. Compute() is the Apple-facing composite Fingerprint (feeds S147-02/03). 13 table-driven tests pinned to vectors from the original Python plus the VOIDONX artifact; all green. Design doc: gpt2-alpine-c/docs/TOWERPRINT.md. commit gpt2-alpine-c 819c400.
